feed.title: Truehound sub-processor changes
feed.subtitle: Material changes to the third parties Truehound engages to deliver a hosted deployment.

entry.title: Register expanded with conditional hosted-platform sub-processors
entry.summary: The register now documents the conditional sub-processors a hosted Truehound tenant may engage when it turns on a capability: product analytics, control-plane telemetry, an edge CDN, customer support, error monitoring, an analytical warehouse, and SMS/voice escalation. All carry an explicit conditional note, none is an always-on dependency, and self-hosted tenants engage none of them.

entry.title: Sub-processor disclosure page + change feed published
entry.summary: Truehound published the public sub-processor register at /trust/subprocessors with an Atom change feed. The register documents AWS (hosting) and Stripe (billing) as the always-on sub-processors, plus the conditional email and SSO-broker providers a tenant can opt into.

entry.title: Stripe confirmed as billing sub-processor
entry.summary: Stripe is engaged for direct-purchase subscription billing and metered usage. Marketplace purchases continue to bypass Stripe (the marketplace is the merchant of record).

entry.title: AWS confirmed as primary infrastructure sub-processor
entry.summary: AWS hosts the BFF, managed Postgres, the Object-Locked audit archive, and KMS-managed keys, in the tenant's selected order-form region.
